dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Might you have any special gadgets in stock?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: A special mechanism, you say? Well, that depends on what you need, Lady Nefer. O{RUBY#[D]Marechaussee Phantom}ur shop has plenty of fine goods to choose from — it all depends on what you're willing to offer.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: It's about Jahoda's a{RUBY#[D]The Seahook Gang}rm. I've heard that some of the s{RUBY#[D]remaining members}pare parts have b{RUBY#[D]made their way to Fontaine}ecome available in Fontaine, so I came to ask if you might know anything about it.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: That might take some time to track down. If the spare parts happen to fall into the r{RUBY#[S]Fleuve Cendre}iver, at least we have some re{RUBY#[S]Spina di Rosula}liable friends who could help retrieve them. But if they're scattered just anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Then I'll be counting on you, Mr. Lestocq. Come to think of it, I just had someone purchase some F{RUBY#[D]intel}onta the other day. I'll send you a few later as thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Much obliged, Lady Nefer. If we do manage to find the parts, I'll have them delivered to you straight away, rest assured.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way — when Miss Jahoda was last here, she seemed rather interested in this toy. Now, I might've just imagined it... but would you mind bringing it to her as well?
